title: Erdős–Pósa-type conjecture for cycles of distinct lengths
statement:
For a graph $G$, let $\Lambda(G)=\{\ell\in\mathbb{N}\mid G\text{ contains a cycle of length }\ell\}$, and let $G-X$ denote the graph obtained by deleting the vertices in $X$. **Distinct-length cycle packing-cover conjecture.** There exists a function $f(k)\in\mathcal{O}(k\log k)$ such that every graph $G$ contains $k$ vertex-disjoint cycles with distinct lengths, or a set $X$ of at most $f(k)$ vertices such that

$$
|\Lambda(G-X)|\leq k-1.
$$

This proposes an Erdős–Pósa-type dual certificate for cycles of pairwise distinct lengths; the source presents it as a possible improvement and does not state that it has been resolved.
source_name: J. Pascal Gollin, Maximilian Gorsky, Meike Hatzel, Kevin Hendrey, Tony Huynh, Caleb McFarland, Marek Sokołowski, Sebastian Wiederrecht and Paul Wollan, “An Erdős-Pósa theorem for cycles and faces of distinct lengths”, arXiv:2607.06869 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.06869

Status: **open** according to the source (as of July 2026). “That is, we leave the following as an open problem.”
